description: This file defines Pydantic data models for schemas related to skills, roles, recommendations, graphs, assessments, and roadmaps in a career pathway navigator application.

classes.name: RecommendationOut
classes.description: Schema for recommendation output with fields like id, type, title, url, details, priority.

classes.name: SkillOut
classes.description: Schema for skill output with id, name, category, description.

classes.name: RoleSkillOut
classes.description: Schema linking skills to roles with required level, gap info, and recommendations.

classes.name: RoleOut
classes.description: Basic role schema with id, name, description.

classes.name: RoleDetailOut
classes.description: Extended role schema including list of skills.

classes.name: ProgressOut
classes.description: Schema for tracking progress on skills within roles.

classes.name: GraphNode
classes.description: Graph node schema for D3 visualization, including id, type, label, progress, etc.

classes.name: GraphLink
classes.description: Graph link schema representing relationships between nodes.

classes.name: GraphMeta
classes.description: Metadata for graph visualization, including role info and stats.

classes.name: GraphOut
classes.description: Schema for outputting complete graph data with nodes, links, and meta.

classes.name: AssessmentIn
classes.description: Input schema for skill assessment between current and target roles.

classes.name: AssessmentItem
classes.description: Item representing a skill's current, required, and gap levels.

classes.name: AssessmentOut
classes.description: Output schema summarizing strengths and gaps.

classes.name: SkillRoleOut
classes.description: Reverse view of skills within roles, including gap info.

classes.name: SkillDetailOut
classes.description: Detailed skill schema including associated roles.

classes.name: RoadmapIn
classes.description: Input schema for creating or updating a roadmap.

classes.name: RoadmapOut
classes.description: Output schema for a roadmap entry.
